scope: Existing SAVE/policy/DDL unchanged. Actual transfer positive quantities/warehouse visibility and disabled-out nonzero/disabled SKU retention rules remain original. No sales rules borrowed. No business DML/number allocation or PG READ ONLY claim. New write-contract difference must be reported first.

lineTypes.quantity: positive canonical exact integer text within existing signed bigint storage; zero/negative rejected

forbidden: sales business type, prices, amounts, settlements or signed return rules
new native line UUID or source/stock metadata

response.draft: Existing TransferDraft wire with exact quantity strings; original transferId and number retained, no number allocation
response.notAuthorization: SAVE keeps independent requestKey, full current auth/reference and CAS; preparation may repeat without business state reservation

nativeIdentityRules.pointer: Each nonnull existingLineId unique, actual owner=current transfer and isCurrent=true; no foreign adoption/noncurrent resurrection. Assign1..N in explicit input order, no SKU merging or implicit sort.
nativeIdentityRules.sameSKU: Retain actual existing line ID and original snapshot/barcode, change only explicit quantity/order in returned draft.
nativeIdentityRules.newOrReplacedSKU: New pointer or changed SKU allocates a distinct server transferLine ID and current actual native MAIN snapshot. Old ID omitted from new current draft; existing unchanged SAVE merge keeps old line isCurrent=false/snapshot unchanged.
nativeIdentityRules.creation: Existing createdBy/createdHall/createdRole/time are not client proposal fields, not regenerated; original SAVE retains them.

transferSpecificPolicy.actor: Trusted authenticated TransferActor includes accountId/hallId/role. Existing transfer transaction has no SalesCurrentIdentity port; do not invent or copy sales role restrictions. Current host auth and existing transfer authorization remain mandatory, repeated at actual SAVE.
transferSpecificPolicy.oldAndProposedScope: First authorize actual stored document, then proposed draft with previous=document. SALESPERSON current hall sees either actual endpoint OR trusted historical salesperson creation-hall branch, exactly existing transfer policy; ADMIN/WAREHOUSE follow original policy. No invented same-hall endpoint requirement or sales own-creator approval rule.
transferSpecificPolicy.warehouses: Both actual warehouse facts; from != to. Existing policy allows disabled outgoing warehouse only when its actual hasNonzeroInventory fact is true (nonzero, not guessed positive or selected-SKU inventory); disabled destination cannot receive. Do not add a new hall_enabled restriction absent from original policy.
transferSpecificPolicy.disabledSKU: Existing source reference provider permits retention/reduction at unchanged endpoints using prior aggregate allowance, including split rows; preserve that validation, do not copy sales all-enabled rule. Retained same-ID/same-SKU snapshots require no fresh enabled-MAIN lookup. New/replaced rows still need actual native MAIN as original manual transfer profile; no fabricated snapshot fallback.
transferSpecificPolicy.quantity: Transfer positive quantity only. No signed RETURN/EXCHANGE economics, money, sales settlement, or net-due checks.
transferSpecificPolicy.state: Only actual RUNTIME_LEDGER DRAFT and exact expectedVersion; CUTOFF_HISTORY remains HISTORY-only. APPROVE/UNAPPROVE/VOID transitions and stock ledger unchanged.

readSequence: Closed own-data parse/IDs/budgets before async; trusted actor only.
One original transfer UOW; server private nonce getReceipt binds original actor without receipt insert, then getTransfer once. Authorize stored record before disclosing state/version.
Check original stockBasis/DRAFT/version and all pointers. Prepare original id/number with explicit new endpoints/quantity and original snapshots for retained sameSKU rows.
Authorize proposed draft with previous original to retain correct creation-hall semantics. Sequential actual warehouse/SKU facts on the same client; no overlapping query calls on bounded client.
Get current native snapshots only for new/replaced IDs, validate via unchanged createNativeManualTransferReferences/source policy with previous doc; enforce current response/SAVE budgets.

Return complete expectedVersion+draft. No putRuntimeTransfer/putBalance/appendLedger/appendAudit/insertReceipt/number reserve/assert or posting entry call. Read view denies and poisons caught attempts; closes on callback exit.
contract.readOnlyMeaning: Zero business DML. Existing READ COMMITTED/advisory/FOR UPDATE/FOR SHARE locks allowed; not PostgreSQL READ ONLY. Warehouse nonzero fact is a real SELECT, no sparse zero materialization.

errors.reuse: Existing safe transfer 400/403/404/409/422/413 mappings; no raw SQL/provider text
errors.pointer: Foreign/noncurrent/duplicate pointer => INVALID_HTTP_INPUT400 as a new read proposal validation, no SAVE rule change
errors.failure: No partial prepared response; F1 retains original local form and conflicts/disabled references; no CREATE proof substitution

contract.optionalHostPort: Independent existingPreparation:{prepareExisting}; export suggested createNativeTransferExistingPreparation(dependencies), separate closed existing parser. Missing provider404, does not reuse preparation:prepareCreate presence.
